# Healthplus International

> Healthplus International is a healthcare workforce development organisation based in Helensburgh, New South Wales, Australia. HPI recruits, employs and places Healthcare Workers across Sydney and regional NSW. Its approach combines role-specific readiness checks, recruitment and matching, placement planning and ongoing workforce support.

Website: https://healthplusint.com.au/
Updated: 16 November 2026
Brand pillars: People · Care · Compliance

## What HPI does

- Works with healthcare, aged care and community-service employers on workforce requirements in NSW.
- Recruits, employs and places healthcare workers. HPI is not offering an employer-of-record (EOR) outsourcing product.
- Coordinates relevant registration, qualification, identity, work-right and screening checks before commencement, according to the role.
- Supports placement arrangements and follow-up. The host service retains day-to-day work direction and clinical governance.
- Does not provide professional training, guarantee a placement, claim affiliation with NSW Health, or promise 24/7 staffing.

## Roles and locations

Roles discussed include Registered Nurses, Enrolled Nurses, Assistants in Nursing, Aged Care Workers, community Support Workers and Allied Health Professionals, subject to requirements and availability.

Selected allied health enquiries may include occupational therapy, physiotherapy, psychology, podiatry and dietetics. Matching considers discipline, caseload, scope of practice, supervision, professional qualifications and registration or credentials where required. The host service retains clinical governance, local induction and day-to-day professional supervision.

Nursing and care placements include Registered Nurses, Enrolled Nurses and Assistants in Nursing for hospital, residential aged care, respite, community and regional services. HPI coordinates role-specific compliance, rostering, commencement and early-placement follow-up. Healthcare Workers register in two steps with their résumé, contact details, profession, preferred locations and availability; compliance documents follow the initial review for a suitable role.

Locations include Sydney, the Central Coast and regions of NSW such as Far West, Western NSW, Murrumbidgee/Riverina, Hunter New England, Northern NSW and Mid North Coast. A listed role or region is not a representation of a current vacancy or guaranteed supply.

## Enquiries

Employers can submit a request at https://healthplusint.com.au/employers#request. HPI acknowledges enquiries and makes contact within one business day.

Healthcare Workers can submit a résumé and preferred locations at https://healthplusint.com.au/work-with-us#apply. Employment opportunities are discussed individually; registration does not guarantee a job.
